# Test fixtures

Small real pages from German Wiktionary, one per parsing edge case. They are copied verbatim from the dump named below and are **not** covered by the repository's BSD licence: their text is licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) by the Wiktionary contributors. The authors of each page are listed in its version history at `https://de.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=<title>&action=history`; the revision used is recorded in the file or in the table below.

| File | Source | Edge case |
|---|---|---|
| `mini-dump.xml` | `dewiktionary-20261101-pages-articles.xml.bz2`: siteinfo and the pages µm, Fluß, Häuser, Flexion:kaufen | dump reader: redirect page, German entry without part-of-speech section (old spelling), form entry, `Flexion:` namespace |
| `flexion/*.wiki` | `Flexion:` pages from the same dump, each file one page: übergeben (revision 7864316), denken (7004844), abrutschen (10396142), umstellen (8083352), sammeln (7968735), knien (7553983), Rad fahren (10802774), müssen (6874550), reisen (7289253), reden (7227126), atmen (7028363), tun (4284203), finden (4286199), halten (4109580), bausparen (7135761), brustschwimmen (7175860), werfen (5483696), stehen (4307553), rennen (7727279), sein (10140425), gehören (7418860), verifizieren (7820156), gebären (4898181), bieten (8726410), heben (10139358) | verb templates: several conjugations on one page, particles, vowel change, mixed inflection, modal verb, stems in `d`, `m`, `s`, `el`, `ie`, forms given by named arguments, no main-clause forms, a verb written as two words, a particle spelled differently when separated, subjunctive II stems that do not follow from the preterite, inseparable prefixes, `sein`, variant stems |
